bm25f title weight 2-3 (first line as ti.note: no title on FiQA/memory; the comparators would need the same fields

rule: Candidate or combination with the best mean paired gain on development nDCG@10 and recall@100,
(a) no development corpus significantly worse (mean difference + 1.96 se < 0) on either metric, and none lower by more than 0.003 on a corpus of at least 1,000 queries,
(b) a query-time cost that keeps every QPS verdict a win (FiQA margin 1.16x ids contract), and no index growth (positions off by default; index size and ingest time are open GAPS rows).
Kept only if no one of the eight reported cells is lower than current WARM; WIN only when the Bonferroni paired interval against the best comparator excludes zero.

verdicts.bm25+/bm25L: killed (a): significantly worse on SCIDOCS, FiQA recall, ArguAna, NFCorpus
verdicts.prf: killed (a): FiQA nDCG -0.022 and Quora -0.039 (lambda .3), -0.013 and -0.024 (lambda .2); a second pass would also cost more than the 1.16x FiQA margin; gating found no predictor
verdicts.proximity: killed (a) and (b): Quora -0.013 to -0.015 significant with or without floored pair weights, memory +0.02 within noise; positions are off by default (SearchOptions/IngestOptions.positions) so they add index size and ingest time
verdicts.bm25f: not run as default: no title field on FiQA or memory, gain <= 0.004, comparators need matching fields
verdicts.idf floor: survives (a) and (b); free at query time; the only survivor
